column1: # The areas tools\select-checks.ps1 picks checks by (tools\CheckSelector.cs reads this file).
# One area per line: name, the render cases it runs (a regular expression on the case's tag, for render.ps1 -OnlyCases; "-" for none),
# the backends those cases run on, and whether the stock smoke runs (yes/no). An underscore in a pattern also matches a hyphen, and
# "proposal-" may come first: render.ps1's case filter reads the picture's tag (shared-env-vulkan, proposal-shared-env-vulkan).
# The area "mainsample" is one render case from each area, on Vulkan: what Main.cs alone selects (the next full gate runs the full set).
# The stock smoke runs for the areas marked yes, and for files the map places in "smoke" because they send or read grid messages.
# The area "full" stands for the full render set and the stock smoke; tools\check-map.tsv sends to it every path the selector
# cannot place more narrowly, and every path it does not know.
